mentions.name: Arbeitnow
mentions.description: A job board for Germany that aggregates job listings from multiple sources and filters which jobs get through to keep postings relevant to its audience. It runs steadily without frequent changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I run a job board for Germany called Arbeitnow. It runs well without any frequent changes. Recently I've added a couple of new sources for jobs and filtering the kind of jobs that get through (relevant to my audience).
